implementation.detail: Implementation commit 4edff6d4d9de0cf9d0da24845e751ec8f7eea23f adds exactly three allowed new files and changes no existing file: tools/tokenized_shards.py (SHA-256 379f3fff79720dc8fb057836daa5173d48fad6fc03f65c2320463df0974b4744), tools/test_tokenized_shards.py (SHA-256 1e7f79d9b41917b597913006d24fc4ca32b1e3c2d9854148d512651039a70f80) and research/data/tokenized-shards.md (SHA-256 3d61df55ff0dccc55c2d4c4d7dab251377d35d01562845ae45fc481126bdaca7). The bridge uses the accepted corpus report and train-only BPE artifact, encodes eligible representatives once, packs whole documents with exact BOS/EOS/pad/valid/document/position and offset-1/2 semantics, and emits canonical tokenizer/manifest/JSONL shards with logical, packed-logical and physical manifest digests. The verified loader checks the complete file set, canonical bytes, schemas, counts, token ranges, masks, labels, hash integrity and independently repacked blocks; materialization is atomic and refuses overwrite. No model, fixture, harness, registry, config or CI file changed.

The demo has 11 documents, 4 blocks, 3 shards, 203 content/22 special/225 valid/159 pad tokens and 214 NTP/203 offset-2 labels; two independent materializations were byte-identical, and a different shard partition preserved logical/packed digests while changing the physical manifest.

limitations: Synthetic documents only; no external corpus, source-rights decision, clearance, acquisition, PII filtering or benchmark corpus.
Small reference format, not production-scale sharding, streaming, compression, memory mapping, concurrent writers or distributed storage.
Packed shards intentionally use whole documents and homogeneous blocks; no automatic document segmentation for overlong documents.
No production tokenizer backend, special-token training, SentencePiece/HF compatibility or serving work.
No quality, throughput, tokenizer fertility or downstream model claim.
Cross-platform shard equality is not claimed until a separate Linux comparison verifies the canonical demo digests.
Production tokenizer/source provenance and materialization remain separate reviewed gates.
